Executive Summary & Architecture This platform enables users to visually design voice agents (ElevenLabs style) that are specifically optimized for Indian languages (Hindi, Hinglish, Tamil, etc.) using Sarvam AI's models. High-Level Data Flow 1. Phone Call: Customer calls a Twilio number. 2. WebSocket: Twilio connects to our FastAPI backend via WebSocket. 3. STT (Ear): Incoming audio (Mulaw) is transcoded and sent to Sarvam Saaras (via WebSocket) for real-time transcription. 4. Brain: The Workflow Engine processes the text against the user-defined JSON graph. 5. TTS (Mouth): Response text is sent to Sarvam Bulbul V3 . 6. Output: Audio is played back to the caller. 7. Analysis: After the call, the transcript is sent to an LLM for "Oration-style" extraction (Sentiment, Intent, Action Items). Tech Stack ● Backend: Python 3.11, FastAPI, Uvicorn, Websockets. ● Frontend: Next.js 14, React Flow, TailwindCSS, Shadcn UI. ● Database: Firestore (for storing agent configurations and call logs). ● Telephony: Twilio (Media Streams).

Chapter 1: The "Indian" Model Layer To build a robust system, we must not hardcode Sarvam. We use the Provider Pattern . This allows us to swap Sarvam for Deepgram or OpenAI later if needed, but defaults to Sarvam for now. 2.1 Abstract Base Classes Create a file app/services/ai_providers.py: from abc import ABC, abstractmethod from typing import AsyncGenerator, Optional class STTProvider(ABC): """Abstract Speech-to-Text Provider""" @abstractmethod async def connect(self): """Establish connection to the provider""" pass @abstractmethod async def send_audio(self, audio_chunk: bytes): """Send raw audio bytes""" pass @abstractmethod async def receive_text(self) -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]: """Yield transcribed text""" pass class TTSProvider(ABC): """Abstract Text-to-Speech Provider""" @abstractmethod async def generate_audio(self, text: str, voice_id: str, language: str) -> bytes: """Return audio bytes for the given text""" pass
